newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell sees "dougle digit" net growth.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell sees "dougle digit" net growth.

text.p: Honeywell Inc said on Thursday that it expects average sales growth of eight to 10 percent and continued annual "double digit" earnings growth through the year 2000.
Michael Bonsignore, chairman and chief executive officer, reviewed his outlook for the company with investors and analysts this morning and the company later issued a statement.
"Our outlook calls for double-digit increases in earnings per share and free cash flow annually," Bonsignore said in a statement.
Honeywell said it plans to expand its international business, enhance its product portfolio and make complementary acquisitions.
Honeywell reported 1996 sales of $7.3 billion and earnings of $402.7 million, or $3.18 per share.
